what: Table 10 Dream runner for the VR cup handover: a voice request in VR makes Dream pick up the cup at Table 10 in the editor world the headset shows; a put-down request sets it back and returns the arms to idle.
why: Requested through the VR session for Denys: hand a cup to the robot in VR, say "take the cup", Dream picks it up, and the real arms can follow through the Table 10 link.
details: Test: left arm held the cup 12.7 cm up (4.4 deg tilt) after 1 Dream grasp and 2 Dream lift calls; put-down returned the cup upright.
Planned reach, Dream grasp with the arm held still, Dream lift with only Dream's upward motion; editor-world kinematic carry of the cup.
Real arms were unplugged during the test; the real-arm hardware dropout under torque is documented separately.
